text:
The equation for the reaction between aluminium and iron(III) oxide is shown.
2Al  +  Fe2O3→  Al2O3  +  2Fe
Which statement about this reaction is correct?
A
The aluminium acts as an oxidising agent.
B
It shows that iron is more reactive than aluminium.
C
The oxidation number of the aluminium decreases during the reaction.
D
It shows that aluminium has a greater tendency to form ions than iron.

options.label: A
options.text: The aluminium acts as an oxidising agent.

options.label: B
options.text: It shows that iron is more reactive than aluminium.

options.label: C
options.text: The oxidation number of the aluminium decreases during the reaction.

options.label: D
options.text: It shows that aluminium has a greater tendency to form ions than iron.
